CellTerminal.binding: panel_key is exactly the first seven cell_key fields; public case and both phase envelopes must bind this same original person and exact full key. Every expected slot remains present even when collection or publication fails.
CellTerminal.errors: First and secondary original errors and failed FIT/INFER or collection/report phase are retained. An unattempted cell names its exact causal failed cell/phase/campaign event without fabricating an own process exit or copying another cell's cost. Unobserved quantities stay explicitly unknown.
CellTerminal.identity: exact eight-field cell_key; one original outer person and one original public case identity
CellTerminal.support: Admissible structural/custody support is either all 200 queries or zero. A malformed, missing, duplicate, late, unqualified or unsafe case is not partially accepted. No probabilities or targets are needed to determine this structural support. Numeric scores stay unavailable until protected grading is separately authorized.

PanelSummary.child_membership: Exactly one child for each original outer person in outer_people, all with this exact panel prefix, no duplicates, substitutions, other-arm or other-system children. Child order is outer_people order, independent of arrival order.

diagnostic_bounds.correct_completed: sum of original assignment-correct counts in the admitted complete 200-query children only, never a fabricated number in a metadata example
diagnostic_bounds.label: incomplete-panel assignment bounds; never a valid primary panel score
diagnostic_bounds.requires: separately authorized diagnostic grader; all safety barriers; every counted child complete, valid and safely closed; no unknown containment anywhere in campaign

PanelSummary.identity: exact seven-field panel_key, with no outer_person field
PanelSummary.state_rule: All ten valid children yield complete_valid; if at least one valid child has calibration_uninformative and the others are valid, yield complete_valid_calibration_uninformative. Any invalid or unattempted child yields incomplete. If the PanelSummary itself cannot be durably constructed/published, retain report_unavailable in reserved external custody. No priority ordering may overwrite a child's actual failure or unknown cost.
PanelSummary.support: expected_queries remains 2000; admissible_queries is the sum of child admissible_queries and unavailable_queries=2000-admissible_queries. An incomplete primary score is unavailable, never zero or a mean over fewer children. Complete primary score is the unchanged equal-ten-person macro mean, not a changed estimand.

PhaseEnvelope.cardinality_not_process_count: Exactly 1920 logical expected FIT/INFER envelopes, not 1920 new physical processes or training fits. An envelope binds original process receipts, or an explicit legitimate no-fit/reuse/unattempted disposition; it never invents a natural completion.
PhaseEnvelope.failure: If FIT fails safely, INFER is explicitly unattempted_after_failure; a whole-cell unattempted disposition has two unattempted envelopes. Unknown containment is never converted to unattempted safe closure. Inner-search/tool operations retain their own original records linked to this envelope; they do not add outer cells.
PhaseEnvelope.identity: exact eight-field cell_key plus phase FIT or INFER
PhaseEnvelope.inference: Each changed current-cell query view requires its actual own production/call evidence. Repeating deterministic identical-input outputs for a paired contrast is a report relation, not an extra cell, phase execution or observed call.
PhaseEnvelope.reference_fit: R0 FIT is declared_no_fit with the original no-training rule. Qualified R1/R2/R3 training-bank reuse binds its unique original producer receipts and full standalone attributable cost. The unique physical fit ledger remains separate; the 8520 distinct-reference-fit estimate is unchanged.

ProtectedReport.campaign_status: Complete comparative science requires all 960 cell dispositions valid, all 96 complete panel summaries, all 1920 phase envelopes, complete required reports and all applicable qualification evidence. A count-consistent metadata report does not establish any of these empirical qualifications.
ProtectedReport.contrast_support: All 32 contrast rows remain. A contrast requiring any unavailable participating panel/replicate is unavailable; no seed/person/arm/reference or family is dropped. Complete unaffected absolute panels may remain visible after global safety admission. Any missing member of the 32-contrast family makes its joint band unavailable; individually eligible descriptive intervals remain labeled and preserve their own complete support.
ProtectedReport.costs: Physical unique operation IDs are counted once; per-cell standalone attributable costs remain separate and are never added to physical costs. Failed, unattempted, unknown and reused operations retain explicit provenance. Cell/panel record counts are not fit counts or cost evidence.
ProtectedReport.global_barrier: Any unresolved containment or unavailable required durable original custody prevents all target and protected scoring-bank opening. Safe incomplete panels may have separately authorized diagnostic reports only; do not relax global safety to report an unaffected panel.
ProtectedReport.registry: CampaignPlan commits exact expected keys and reporting schema before exposure. Missing observed records produce explicit unavailable/unattempted reserved dispositions at those keys, not deletion or fabricated receipts; malformed raw evidence is retained separately and is not accepted under a substitute key.

precedence: This exact unit typing governs current S3 reporting, refining inherited S2 wording only. Numerical scoring, permitted information, mode permissions, source/profile differences and qualification gates are unchanged. Historical contracts remain immutable evidence, never alternate S3 rules.
scope: One evaluation of one candidate system plus all four named independent references. More candidate systems do not fit silently inside this registry.
status: normative declarative design; not an implementation or observed report
